headline: Barely knee-high — flat side of loggable.
today: Tiny S swell, short period, but the wind is friendly: cross-off to offshore and light, glassing off to 3mph in the evening. There's not much to work with, so this is a longboard-only, expectations-in-the-basement kind of day. If you're already local, the morning offshore or the glassy dusk are your windows; otherwise not worth leaving the house.

daysToWatch.note: Wind ramps to 18mph then 26mph SSW by evening — blown out and getting worse. Don't bother.
Small but the cleanest of the back half — 1.5ish at a good angle with N offshore all day. Grovel-worthy if you want to get wet.
